title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have we had anybody at any of these Texas games?
Straight up, regardless of the people you deal with
This team is ducking terrible. It pisses me off when I turn on the radio
Thank you. I’m so glad to be leaving. Let’s catch up when you’re back.
Did you tell Jen? I know she was there.
It was great. I’m driving to Ann Arbor right now. Went to every practice, hustled my ass off. Felt good. Probably go to clubhouse 20% of the time with these bums
Right. Yeah it’s a whole other gear when you’re out there thriving.
